content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
[h1]EOC - Executive Operations Center[/h1]
A governance-first operations layer for X4: Foundations. EOC observes your empire, explains recurring station problems, recommends bounded actions, and keeps execution under player control.
[h2]Important Startup Timing[/h2]
After loading a game, wait about 10 seconds for the initial station scan to complete before opening EOC. The readiness summary confirms current data is available.
[h2]What EOC Does[/h2]
[list] [*][b]Executive Intelligence[/b] - Empire health, operational KPIs, trends, ranked attention, and station summaries. [*][b]Station Management[/b] - Persistent station roles, role-aware recommendations, advisory operating policies, production, workforce, economy, and storage intelligence. [*][b]Guided Recovery[/b] - One blocker at a time, supporting evidence, one recommended player action, and fresh verification. [*][b]Safe Market-Path Tests[/b] - Preview and confirm one bounded NPC-enabled BUY or SELL offer without changing existing ware rules or ordinary offers. [*][b]Managed Trade[/b] - Evidence-supported EOC trade offers within authority explicitly granted by the player. [*][b]Shipping and Logistics[/b] - Register eligible ships, scan needs, approve assignments, or use bounded automatic assignment. [*][b]Fleet Build Manager[/b] - Save fleet templates, search owned blueprints, preview one-yard or distributed construction, and confirm normal player-yard orders. [*][b]Cases and Verification[/b] - Track critical, warning, monitored, and player-requested cases; report Resolved, Improving, Unchanged, or Worsening from fresh evidence. [*][b]Reports[/b] - Immediate EOC reports plus permanent Logbook Tips copies. [*][b]Player-Controlled Safety[/b] - Deliberate previews, amber confirmations, exact cleanup, duplicate prevention, no free ships, no resource bypass, and no unauthorized credit movement. [*][b]Direct EOC Access[/b] - Open EOC from Dock Interactions in any supported player context; separate pinwheel navigation remains available. [*][b]Named Command Intelligence[/b] - Choose a persistent EOC name and enjoy a guided startup sequence clearly separated from operational evidence.
[/list]
[h2]New in EOC 2.8 GA[/h2]
[list] [*]Reassigns an eligible player construction vessel from another role and targets it to the selected station's exact build request using X4's native construction workflow. [*]Verifies the exact vessel is attached before reporting success; live testing confirmed the reassigned Elephant actively advanced station construction. [*]Adds an explicit SAVE GLOBAL SETTINGS workflow with amber unsaved state and green saved confirmation. [*]Makes the optional computer loading screen preference persist correctly per save; it remains ON by default until the player explicitly turns it off and saves the setting. [/list]
[h2]Make a Successful Market Test Permanent[/h2]
EOC never converts a bounded test into permanent policy automatically. Open the station Logical Overview, select the tested ware's buy or sell offer, and change only its ware-specific trade rule. Change a station-wide rule only when you intend the wider effect. Then remove the temporary EOC test offer.
[h2]Getting Started[/h2]
1. Load the game and wait about 10 seconds for EOC initialization.
2. Open Dock Interactions from the top HUD menu in space, aboard a ship, or on a station.
3. Select OPEN EXECUTIVE OPERATIONS CENTER.
4. On first use, choose a name for the command intelligence.
EOC supports X4 8.x and 9.x. UI Extensions and HUD is no longer required. Removing EOC does not make an existing save dependent on the mod.
[h2]Credits[/h2]
Created by [b]RazorEQX[/b].
Special thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/XaosSpecter][b]Reuivn[/b][/url] for proposing Personal Office access.
